difficulty_definitions.easy: Solvable with whole-number intermediate steps, all cards 1-9, and at least 3 distinct solutions.
difficulty_definitions.medium: Solvable with whole-number intermediate steps, all cards 1-9, but only 1-2 distinct solutions.
difficulty_definitions.hard: Solvable with whole-number intermediate steps, with at least one card in 10-13.
difficulty_definitions.expert: Solvable only via fraction intermediates — no whole-number-step solution exists (e.g. 8 / (3 - 8 / 3)).
